newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba - sales of Bobl series 122 to halt May 20.
newsitem.headline: Buba - sales of Bobl series 122 to halt May 20.

text.p: The German federal government will suspend sales of the first tranche of the series 122 5-year Bundesobligation, or Bobl, on May 20, the Bundesbank said on Tuesday.
The central bank said Bonn will sell a second tranche of about 10 billion marks in a topping-up auction on May 21.
Bids for the second tranche of the Series 122 Bobl are due by 0900 GMT on May 21. The issue will start trade on May 26, the Bundesbank said.
The size of the tranche was in line with a previous statement from the Bundesbank.

The government normally sells the first tranche of each Bobl Series to a limited range of investors and offers a second tranche through competitive auction to credit institutions after closing the first tranche.
